description: PII detection and redaction, remove personal data and secrets from text. Find and redact personal and secret data in text by pattern: email addresses, phone numbers, payment card numbers (Luhn-checked), IBANs, US SSNs, IP addresses, API keys and tokens, and passwords in URLs. Returns the redacted text and what was found (types and positions, not the values). Pattern-based: it can miss things, and it does not detect names or street addresses. Runs in memory only; the text is never stored or logged. Price: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base).
name: pii_redact
